name: make-oss-sdk-apps
description: This is a testing repo used to test workflow during the development of the Github open-source apps project.

scripts.pull: read -p "App name: " APP && npx make-cli pull --local-dir ./apps/$APP
scripts.push: read -p "App name: " APP && npx make-cli push --local-dir ./apps/$APP
scripts.clone: read -p "App name: " APP && npx make-cli clone $APP --local-dir ./apps/$APP --make-host eu1.make.com
